answers.title: Is the PMP exam changing in 2026?
answers.question: Is the PMP exam changing in 2026?
answers.description: Independent answer on the 2026 PMP exam transition, key dates, and how candidates should verify official PMI guidance.
answers.shortAnswer: Yes. PMI has communicated an updated PMP exam experience with a transition around 9 July 2026. Confirm dates and scope on PMI.org before scheduling.

answers.title: When does the new PMP exam start?
answers.question: When does the new PMP exam start?
answers.description: Answer on the July 2026 PMP transition date and how to confirm scheduling with PMI and Pearson VUE.
answers.shortAnswer: PM Structure orients candidates to a key transition date of 9 July 2026 for the updated PMP format. Always confirm on PMI.org before you book.

answers.title: Should I take the PMP before 8 July 2026?
answers.question: Should I take the PMP before 8 July 2026?
answers.description: Decision guide for candidates considering the current PMP format before the July 2026 transition.
answers.shortAnswer: Consider testing before the transition if you are already exam-ready, have strong mock scores, and can secure a Pearson VUE slot before mid-2026.

answers.title: Should I prepare for the new PMP after 9 July 2026?
answers.question: Should I prepare for the new PMP after 9 July 2026?
answers.description: When it makes sense to target the post-July 2026 PMP exam and how to align practice.
answers.shortAnswer: Yes: if you need more study time, missed the pre-transition window, or want to align preparation to the updated exam narrative PMI describes for post-9 July 2026.

answers.title: What is the PMP Business Environment domain?
answers.question: What is the PMP Business Environment domain?
answers.description: Plain-language explanation of the PMP Business Environment domain and how to study it for 2026.
answers.shortAnswer: The Business Environment domain covers organizational context, benefits, compliance, value delivery, and how project decisions support business outcomes.

answers.title: How to prepare for the PMP in 2026
answers.question: How do I prepare for the PMP in 2026?
answers.description: Step-by-step PMP 2026 preparation: timing, ECO mapping, pathways, mocks, and official verification.
answers.shortAnswer: Confirm eligibility, choose pre- or post-July timing, map the ECO to a weekly plan, pick a pathway tier, and use mocks plus scenario practice before Pearson VUE.

answers.title: What is PMP readiness?
answers.question: What is PMP readiness?
answers.description: Definition of PMP exam readiness: mocks, domains, situational judgment, and when to schedule.
answers.shortAnswer: PMP readiness means consistent performance on timed mocks, ECO coverage, and confidence in situational judgment: not only finishing course videos.

answers.title: How long does PMP preparation take?
answers.question: How long does PMP preparation take?
answers.description: Typical PMP study duration by pathway tier and factors that shorten or lengthen prep.
answers.shortAnswer: Many candidates need several weeks to a few months. PM Structure catalogue guides suggest roughly 2 weeks (Foundation), 6 weeks (Professional), and 12 weeks (Mastery): your pace may differ.

answers.title: What is PMP scenario practice?
answers.question: What is PMP scenario practice?
answers.description: Explanation of situational PMP practice and how it fits Foundation, Professional, and Mastery tiers.
answers.shortAnswer: Scenario practice trains how you apply PM concepts in exam-style situations: the skill tested on current and transitioning PMP formats.

answers.title: What is the PMP Exam Content Outline?
answers.question: What is the PMP Exam Content Outline (ECO)?
answers.description: What the PMP ECO is, where to download it, and how to use it in a 2026 study plan.
answers.shortAnswer: The ECO is PMI’s published list of domains and tasks used to build the PMP exam. Download the current version from PMI.org and map every study week to it.

answers.title: Is PM Structure a PMI ATP?
answers.question: Is PM Structure a PMI Authorized Training Partner (ATP)?
answers.description: Clarifies PM Structure’s independent exam-prep status and PMI ATP positioning.
answers.shortAnswer: No: unless formally confirmed on a live page, PM Structure is an independent exam-preparation platform, not a PMI Authorized Training Partner.

answers.title: Does PM Structure guarantee a PMP pass?
answers.question: Does PM Structure guarantee a PMP pass?
answers.description: Independent answer on exam outcomes, preparation support, and what PM Structure does not promise.
answers.shortAnswer: No. PM Structure does not guarantee PMP exam passage.

answers.title: How does regional PMP pricing work?
answers.question: How does regional pricing work for PMP on PM Structure?
answers.description: Regional scholarship pricing, USD checkout, and what is excluded from PMP tuition.
answers.shortAnswer: Regional scholarship tiers depend on verified residence and billing country. Checkout is processed in USD equivalent. Official PMI exam fees are excluded.

answers.title: When do I get LMS access after PMP enrollment?
answers.question: When do I get LMS access after PMP enrollment?
answers.description: LMS provisioning timeline and what happens after PMP pathway checkout.
answers.shortAnswer: After enrollment is confirmed, learners receive access through the PM Structure learning environment. Timing depends on payment confirmation and onboarding steps in your welcome email.

answers.title: PMP Foundation vs Professional vs Mastery
answers.question: What is the difference between PMP Foundation, Professional, and Mastery?
answers.description: Compare PM Structure PMP pathway tiers: fit, practice depth, and when to choose each.
answers.shortAnswer: Foundation orients new candidates; Professional adds structured scenario practice and mocks; Mastery provides intensive final preparation and weak-area remediation.

answers.title: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
answers.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
answers.description: Independent overview of PMI PMP eligibility: experience hours, education, and how to verify before applying.
answers.shortAnswer: PMI requires a combination of project leadership experience and education (35 contact hours for most applicants). Exact rules change: verify on PMI.org before you apply.

answers.title: What is the PMP People domain?
answers.question: What is the PMP People domain?
answers.description: Explain the People domain in the PMP Exam Content Outline and how to study it.
answers.shortAnswer: The People domain covers leadership, team performance, conflict, and stakeholder engagement: a core third of the PMP ECO.

answers.title: What is the PMP Process domain?
answers.question: What is the PMP Process domain?
answers.description: Explain the Process domain in the PMP ECO and preparation focus on PM Structure.
answers.shortAnswer: The Process domain addresses delivery, scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, and integration: often the largest ECO weight.

answers.title: What is PMP mock exam practice?
answers.question: What is PMP mock exam practice?
answers.description: How timed PMP mocks build readiness and when to use them on PM Structure.
answers.shortAnswer: Mock exams simulate timed PMP-style scenarios so you practice judgment under pressure: not just content recall.

answers.title: How do I enroll in PMP on PM Structure?
answers.question: How do I enroll in PMP on PM Structure?
answers.description: Steps to choose a tier, complete checkout, and access LMS content.
answers.shortAnswer: Select a tier on /certifications/pmp or a dedicated course page, complete regional checkout, then follow LMS access instructions in your confirmation email.

answers.title: What is project management certification?
answers.question: What is project management certification?
answers.description: Overview of PM credentials (PMP, PRINCE2, Six Sigma) and independent prep on PM Structure.
answers.shortAnswer: Project management certification validates experience and knowledge through third-party exams such as PMP, PRINCE2, or Lean Six Sigma belts.

answers.title: What is PRINCE2 certification?
answers.question: What is PRINCE2 certification?
answers.description: PRINCE2 Foundation and Practitioner explained for PM Structure learners.
answers.shortAnswer: PRINCE2 is a structured project management method with Foundation and Practitioner levels, administered by PeopleCert on behalf of AXELOS.

answers.title: What is Lean Six Sigma Green Belt?
answers.question: What is Lean Six Sigma Green Belt?
answers.description: Green Belt role, exam prep, and pathways on PM Structure.
answers.shortAnswer: Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certifies practitioners who lead process improvement projects using DMAIC and basic statistical tools.

answers.title: How many PMP mock exams should I take?
answers.question: How many PMP mock exams should I take?
answers.description: Guidance on mock exam volume for PMP readiness on PM Structure.
answers.shortAnswer: Most candidates benefit from multiple timed mocks with error logging; exact count depends on baseline, exam date, and domain gaps.

answers.title: What are the PMP 2026 domain weights?
answers.question: What are the PMP 2026 domain weights?
answers.description: Orientation on PMP domain weighting for 2026 exam planning.
answers.shortAnswer: PMP uses People, Process, and Business Environment domains. Verify current percentages on PMI.org: do not rely on outdated third-party figures.

answers.title: Current PMP exam vs new PMP exam
answers.question: What is the difference between the current PMP exam and the new PMP exam?
answers.description: Compare pre- and post-July 2026 PMP exam narratives.
answers.shortAnswer: The transition around 9 July 2026 shifts emphasis in exam narratives and ECO tasks. Compare guides on PM Structure and verify on PMI.org.

answers.title: Which PM Structure PMP pathway should I choose?
answers.question: Which PM Structure PMP pathway should I choose?
answers.description: Foundation vs Professional vs Mastery pathway selection.
answers.shortAnswer: Use the readiness diagnostic and pathway comparison on /pmp. Foundation for orientation, Professional for active prep, Mastery for intensive practice.

answers.title: What is PMP Foundation?
answers.question: What is PMP Foundation on PM Structure?
answers.description: PMP Foundation pathway overview on PM Structure.
answers.shortAnswer: Foundation orients candidates to ECO topics and baseline practice before intensive mocks.

answers.title: What is PMP Professional?
answers.question: What is PMP Professional on PM Structure?
answers.description: PMP Professional pathway for active exam preparation.
answers.shortAnswer: Professional adds structured mocks and scenario practice for candidates actively preparing to sit PMP.

answers.title: What is PMP Mastery?
answers.question: What is PMP Mastery on PM Structure?
answers.description: PMP Mastery intensive pathway overview.
answers.shortAnswer: Mastery targets intensive practice, mock review, and exam-week discipline for candidates close to their test date.

answers.title: Is the new PMP exam harder?
answers.question: Is the new PMP exam harder?
answers.description: Independent answer on whether the post-2026 PMP format is harder than the current exam.
answers.shortAnswer: Neither format is universally harder: difficulty depends on your experience, study approach, and how well you match the updated Exam Content Outline.

answers.title: Should I rush PMP before July 2026?
answers.question: Should I rush PMP before July 2026?
answers.description: When rushing before the PMP transition helps: and when it hurts.
answers.shortAnswer: Rush only if you are already exam-ready with strong timed mocks and a booked Pearson VUE slot; otherwise prepare properly for the post-transition format.

answers.title: Can I prepare for PMP in 30 days?
answers.question: Can I prepare for PMP in 30 days?
answers.description: Realistic 30-day PMP prep expectations and when a short timeline works.
answers.shortAnswer: A 30-day sprint is realistic only for experienced PMs with prior ECO exposure, daily study hours, and strong baseline mocks: not for first-time candidates.

answers.title: What is the best PMP study plan?
answers.question: What is the best PMP study plan?
answers.description: How to structure a PMP study plan aligned to the ECO and your exam date.
answers.shortAnswer: The best plan maps weekly hours to ECO domains, includes timed mocks with review, and adjusts as mock data reveals gaps.

answers.title: What should I do after a low PMP mock score?
answers.question: What should I do after a low PMP mock score?
answers.description: Steps to recover from a disappointing PMP mock exam result.
answers.shortAnswer: Log misses by domain, revisit ECO tasks for weak areas, and retake a timed mock only after targeted review: do not schedule the real exam yet.
